Internal helper: standardized residuals of a comparison of groups

Source: R/plot.R
dot-jst_group_std_resid.Rd

Each case's distance from its group's mean, divided by its standard error: e / (s * sqrt(1 - 1/n)), with n the group's size and s the pooled standard deviation (pooled = TRUE, Student's t-test and the traditional ANOVA, where this is rstandard() of the one-way model) or the group's own (pooled = FALSE, Welch's tests, whose groups need not share a variance). A paired test passes the differences as one group. A case of a one-case group, or of a group with no spread, gets NA. What jt() and jaov() return as residuals and the normal Q-Q plot draws (Session 375; ruling R14, part 2).

Usage

.jst_group_std_resid(y, g, pooled = TRUE)

Arguments

y

Numeric vector; the outcome (or the paired differences).

g

The groups, any type; a case missing on either is left out.

pooled

Logical; pool the standard deviation across the groups.

Value

Numeric vector, the cases complete on both, names kept.
